theme.concept: Digital Origami - Precision, Structural Geometry, Craftsmanship
theme.reasoning: A world-class digital product agency requires a high-end, structural aesthetic that commands authority. Moving away from generic bootstrap red/purple, we lean into sharp geometric layouts ('Origami folds'), severe contrasts, and a deep architectural black-and-white base accented by Signal Red.

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' GRID. Asymmetrical bento grids. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8.
layout_and_spacing.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layouts with visible grid lines. Use sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm).

component_strategies.header: Sticky with 'Crystal Glass'. bg-[#050505]/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10. Z-index 50. Must have desktop navigation visible (no hamburger on desktop).

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black font-semibold rounded-none px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#FF3333] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-white/20 bg-transparent text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 hover:border-white hover:bg-white/5 transition-all duration-300

cards.style: Flat background (#111111), sharp edges (rounded-none), 1px border-white/10. NO soft shadows. On hover: border-white/30 and subtle -translate-y-1.

images.overlay: bg-black/40 maximum. Use subtle gradients for text contrast if needed.

hero.layout: Massive typography focus. 2-column on desktop (8-col text, 4-col image/3D art).
elements: H1: 'World-Class Digital Products. On-Time. On-Budget. On-Point.'
CTA group: Primary (Let's Talk) + Secondary (View Work).
Visual: Render the 3D origami crane or abstract geometry.

services_grid.layout: Bento Grid (12-col). Mix of col-span-4, col-span-8, col-span-6 to avoid boring symmetry.
services_grid.visuals: Each service card acts as a 'fold'. Use technical borders.

pillars.style: Highly structural. Big numbers (01, 02) in JetBrains Mono.

industries.layout: Marquee or asymmetrical image-heavy grid. Focus on 'Fantasy Gaming', 'Healthcare', 'Fintech'.

testimonials.layout: Large expressive type quotes, minimal UI. No standard 'card' carousel. Use fading text or full-width slide.

footer.layout: Massive space (py-32). Top: Huge CTA 'Are you ready?'. Bottom: Grid of links and contact.
footer.style: bg-[#111111] with pure white text. Large logo.

animations.interactions: Hover states must have higher contrast. Buttons slide colors.
animations.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Staggered fade-up for bento grids.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 text contrast. White on #050505 is optimal.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'hero-cta-button', 'service-card').

hero_art.description: 3D black origami crane floating in dark void. Use in hero section.

abstract_geometry.description: Abstract dark grey paper folds. Good for Services or About background.

origami_shape.description: Intricate white origami shape. Use in Pillars or Industries section.

office_team_1.description: Corporate team. Use in About or Staffing page.

office_team_2.description: Modern office meeting. Good for IT Staffing / Engagement Models.

tech_pattern.description: Abstract neon technology lines. Use for Technology Expertise tab backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js application using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
Implement the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' dark theme with pitch black (#050505), stark white (#FAFAFA), and Signal Red (#FF3333) accents.
Use standard semantic HTML blocks heavily customized with Tailwind rather than relying solely on generic Shadcn Card layouts. Keep corners sharp (rounded-none).
Font Families: Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, Outfit for Body, JetBrains Mono for overlines and tags. Ensure these are loaded.
Construct the UI entirely in Javascript (.jsx/.js files). NO .tsx.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Rely entirely on the URLs provided in the 'media' object of this JSON.
